growerp.marketing.EmailSequenceStep.subject: Welcome to GrowERP, {name}!
growerp.marketing.EmailSequenceStep.bodyHtml:
Hi {name},

You just logged in to GrowERP for the first time — welcome aboard!

A few things to get you going:

  • Take a look at your dashboard to see what's already set up.
  • Invite a teammate so you're not exploring alone.
  • Check out the built-in demo data to see GrowERP in action.

We'll send a couple more tips over the next week. If anything's unclear, just reply to this email.

growerp.marketing.EmailSequenceStep.subject: 3 things to try in GrowERP
growerp.marketing.EmailSequenceStep.bodyHtml:
Hi {name},

A few days in — here are three things worth trying if you haven't already:

  • Invite your team so everyone works from the same data.
  • Explore the dashboard to see the reports and stats GrowERP tracks for you automatically.
  • Connect your data (products, customers, or accounting) to see GrowERP working with your real business.

Questions? Just reply, we read every email.

growerp.marketing.EmailSequenceStep.subject: How's it going so far?
growerp.marketing.EmailSequenceStep.bodyHtml:
Hi {name},

It's been a week since you started with GrowERP — how's it going?

If you're stuck on anything, or there's a feature you expected to find and couldn't, just reply and let us know. We'd love to help.

If things are going well, that's great to hear too — thanks for giving GrowERP a try!
